newsitem.title: MEXICO: Comerci ends joint venture with Auchan.
newsitem.headline: Comerci ends joint venture with Auchan.

text.p: Mexican retailer Controladora Comercial Mexicana SA (Comerci) said on Friday it had ended its joint venture with French retail company Auchan.

In a statement to the Mexican Stock Exchange, Comerci said both companies would equally split the assets of the joint venture, named Controladora Auchan Mexicana SA. The venture operated hypermarket stores in Mexico.

Comerci, Mexico's second largest retail chain in number of outlets, said it will keep an existing hypermarket store in Mexico City under its own name, while Auchan will keep two other Mexico City stores currently under construction.

The break with Auchan came amid a move by Comerci to buy Kmart Corp's Mexican joint venture, announced on Thursday. Comerci said it will take over Kmart's four existing hypermarket stores in Mexico City and elsewhere as well as one under construction in the central city of Puebla.
Comerci said the purchases will boost its sales space by 60,000 square meters, an increase in its overall sales space of 7.2 percent.
